name: NextDash
description: NextDash is a lightweight, self-hosted bookmark dashboard that features a minimalist, keyboard-driven interface with extensive customization options, making it the perfect personal dashboard for power users. Based on the excellent ThinkDashboard. Key features: • Keyboard-driven navigation for fast access to all your bookmarks • Extensive theme and layout customization • Inbox to collect new links fast: triage them, or keep them on a Kept tab and file whole groups later • Health view that finds broken, stale and duplicate links, with uptime monitoring and downtime alerts • Video bookmarks marked in the list, and played in the hover card without leaving the dashboard • Widgets beside your bookmarks: 21 built-in kinds (uptime, feeds, weather, calendar, disks, containers and more) plus a Custom widget for any JSON API • Six interface languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Chinese • Lightweight and fast, no heavy dependencies • Actively maintained with regular releases Links: • Website: https://www.nextdash.cc • Source code and releases: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash • Changelog: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/releases • Devlog / release updates: https://www.nextdash.cc/news • Also available on GHCR: ghcr.io/jordibrouwer/nextdash:latest • User manual: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/blob/main/MANUAL.md The host widgets (Processor, Memory, Disks, Containers) are off until you fill in the optional paths and variables below — they are hidden under Show more settings. Section 11.4 of the manual explains what each one reads. Support: open an issue on GitHub via the Support link above. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent storage path for NextDash data (bookmarks, settings)

paths.name: Host proc
paths.description: Optional. Mount the host /proc here for the Processor and Memory widgets. Host path: /proc

paths.name: Host disks
paths.description: Optional. Mount the array here for the Disks widget. Host path: /mnt — then name /mnt/user or /mnt/cache in the widget.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Optional. Mount the Docker socket here for the Containers widget. Host path: /var/run/docker.sock — read-only still exposes the daemon's whole read API, so use a socket proxy if that is too much.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the NextDash web interface

variables.name: Write token
variables.description: Optional. Require this token in the X-NextDash-Token header on every write. Leave empty for an open instance on a trusted network.

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: Optional. Addresses and CIDR ranges whose X-Forwarded-For header is believed, comma-separated — set this if nextDash sits behind a reverse proxy, so rate limits count per visitor instead of per proxy. Left empty the header is ignored.

variables.name: Host proc variable
variables.description: Optional. Set to /host/proc once the mount above is filled in.

variables.name: Host root variable
variables.description: Optional. Set to /host/root once the disks mount above is filled in.

variables.name: Docker socket variable
variables.description: Optional. Set to /var/run/docker.sock once the socket mount above is filled in. Unset, the Containers widget is hidden.
